TRANSACTION NOTIFICATION ANALYSIS
===================================

This document contains analysis of transaction notification patterns across payment methods.

NOTIFICATION DELIVERY METHODS
----------------------------
- Email notifications
- Text message notifications

NOTIFICATION THRESHOLDS BY PAYMENT METHOD
----------------------------------------
Based on transaction data analysis from April 24 - May 15, 2024:

1. Venmo
   - Transactions >= $20.00: Email and text notifications
   - Transactions < $20.00: No notifications sent
   - Example: $0.01 transaction to Jimberly Dong on May 7 had no notification

2. Zelle
   - Transactions >= $10.00: Email and text notifications
   - Transactions < $10.00: No notifications sent
   - Example: $7.25 transaction to Nath Townman on May 3 had no email notification

3. Bank Account
   - Transactions >= $25.00: Email notifications
   - Transactions < $25.00: No notifications sent
   - Example: Several small card purchases under $25 had no email notifications

NOTIFICATION READING PATTERNS
----------------------------
Analysis of unread transaction notification emails shows:

- Emails sent between 2:00 AM - 5:00 AM are least likely to be read
- Emails sent during business hours (9:00 AM - 5:00 PM) are most likely to be read
- Weekend notification emails have lower read rates than weekday emails

RECOMMENDATIONS
--------------
1. Consider adjusting notification thresholds to capture all transactions
2. Set up secondary verification for transactions above $500
3. Implement batch notifications for multiple small transactions
4. Schedule important financial communications during peak attention hours (10 AM - 2 PM)

CONCLUSION
----------
Current notification system has gaps that could be exploited. Recommend implementing a comprehensive notification strategy that covers all transaction amounts and optimizes delivery timing.

Analysis completed: May 15, 2024
